description: This Java source file defines the Book entity class, which models a book in the book project. It includes fields for book attributes such as title, author, genres, publication year, reading progress, and relationships to shelves, publishers, and tags. It also contains logic for managing book properties, equality, and edition formatting.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: Entity class representing a book, with properties such as title, author, genres, shelves, tags, publishers, reading status, and related behaviors including edition conversion and relationship management.

methods.name: convertToBookEdition
methods.description: Converts an integer edition number into a string with the correct ordinal suffix (e.g., '1st edition', '2nd edition').

methods.name: setEdition
methods.description: Sets the edition string based on an integer input, using convertToBookEdition.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a Tag to the book's tags set, establishing the bidirectional relationship.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a Tag from the book's tags set, updating the Tag's book list.

methods.name: addPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Associates a predefined shelf with the book, updating both sides of the relationship.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelf
methods.description: Removes the association with the current predefined shelf.

methods.name: removeAuthor
methods.description: Removes the association with the author, updating the author's book list.

methods.name: setPublicationYear
methods.description: Sets the publication year of the book.

methods.name: addGenre
methods.description: Adds a genre to the book's genre set.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a Publisher to the book's publisher set, updating the Publisher's book list.

methods.name: removePublisher
methods.description: Removes a Publisher from the book's publisher set, updating the Publisher's book list.
